title: AI automation discovery
content: Cynbit designs autonomous AI agents, LLM automation, document handling and SaaS integrations. A useful discovery call confirms the repetitive workflow, source systems, volume, human approvals, security constraints and measurable business outcome.

title: Custom software discovery
content: Cynbit builds scalable web and mobile platforms, backend systems and legacy migrations. Scope should establish target users, critical user journeys, integrations, uptime expectations, data sensitivity and delivery milestones.

title: Cloud discovery
content: Cynbit supports AWS and Azure cloud foundations. Establish current architecture, workload criticality, reliability target, compliance requirements, migration constraints and operating ownership.

title: Growth discovery
content: Cynbit provides technical SEO, performance marketing, CRM automation and funnel optimization. Establish target audience, baseline traffic or leads, conversion event, channels, budget and measurement window.
